name: Epistemic Certification

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # R399 W4 LIGHTWEIGHT tier: a push whose EVERY changed file is
    # docs/evidence (markdown, worklog, R-round records) does not run
    # the full certification — the lightweight workflow handles it.
    # Any code-path file in the push re-enables this workflow (GitHub
    # paths-ignore semantics: skip only when ALL files match).

      - "worklog.md"
